coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across foundational HCI theory (Shneiderman, Norman, Card, Pirolli, Tufte, Munzner, Oviatt), peer-reviewed conference papers (CHI, UIST, IEEE VIS/InfoVis), recent arXiv research on hybrid NL+direct-manipulation interfaces, multimodal interaction design, LLM-GUI architectures, visual query languages, and natural language interfaces for data visualization. Canonical authorities on direct manipulation (Hutchins 1985, Shneiderman 1983), information visualization (Card-Mackinlay-Shneiderman, Tufte, Munzner), information foraging (Pirolli-Card), affordances (Norman), and multimodal interfaces (Oviatt) are well-represented. Recent work covers DirectGPT (direct manipulation + LLMs), Graphologue (LLM + interactive diagrams), multimodal GUI architectures (MCP integration), natural language interfaces to databases (NLIDBs, NL4DV), visual analytics with semantic interaction, and mixed-initiative systems. Includes survey papers (NLI4DB, visualization surveys, semantic parsing) and seminal papers on dialogue design, conversational grounding, sketch-based interfaces, and human-centered AI collaboration. Deduplication removed identical URLs across search results and consolidated papers appearing in multiple indexes. Notable deferrals: specialized vision-language model internals (beyond ScreenAI), real-time rendering architectures, mobile touch gesture databases (covered at behavioral level), deprecated 1990s-2000s SQL GUI tools (obsoleted by modern tools), and pure NLP/semantic parsing theory separate from UI context.

sources.title: Direct Manipulation Interfaces

sources.title: Direct Manipulation: Comprehensible, Predictable and Controllable User Interfaces
sources.notes: Seminal work establishing three principles of direct manipulation: continuous representation, physical actions, rapid/reversible feedback; foundational for MetroGraph's interaction model

sources.title: Direct Manipulation vs. Interface Agents: Revisiting the Classic HCI Debate
sources.notes: Dialogue between Shneiderman and Pattie Maes on tension between direct manipulation and intelligent agents; essential for understanding hybrid interface tradeoffs

sources.title: Don Norman's Principles of Interaction Design
sources.notes: Canonical treatment of affordances, signifiers, constraints, mappings, feedback, and conceptual models in interaction design; core to interface design theory

sources.title: Edward Tufte: Information Design and Visualization Principles
sources.notes: Seminal works (Visual Display of Quantitative Information, Envisioning Information, Visual Explanations) establishing data-ink ratio, graphical integrity, and clarity principles for visualization design

sources.title: Readings in Information Visualization: Using Vision to Think
sources.notes: Foundational collection by Stuart Card, Jock Mackinlay, Ben Shneiderman on information visualization theory and techniques; establishes visualization framework

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design

sources.title: The Use of Proximal Information Scent to Forage for Distal Content

sources.title: QuickSet: Multimodal Interaction for Distributed Applications

sources.title: Query by Example (QBE)

sources.title: Graphologue: Exploring Large Language Model Responses with Interactive Diagrams
